answer: Each identity binds one granted patent: its number and inventor hash enter the Pearl Registry, with a 30 POA bond locked 90 days in the vault. Each epoch the patent office re-attests the grant within 72 hours; two misses forfeit half the bond and freeze payouts 3 epochs. A second patent from one funding cluster doubles the bond to 60 POA, a third to 120, so the tenth fake costs 15,360 POA and 100 fakes need 100 granted patents. Duplicate filings find no haven in the registry: one patent backs exactly one identity. Co-inventors share a patent, so only the first-named inventor may bind it.
